# COUNTY OF SUMMIT REGULAR COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES

A Caucus was held prior to the meeting to discuss Agenda items. Pamela Pinkney addressed Council with a public comment.

The Council Regular Meeting was called to order at 04:58 PM in Council Chambers. ROLL CALL-Present: Mrs. Darrow, Ms. Dickinson, Mr. Donofrio, Mr. Ford; Absent: MINUTES FOR APPROVAL: Mrs. McKenney moved to approve the minutes of the regular Council meeting(s) held April 14, 2025. Voice Vote on the motion. Yes: Darrow, Dickinson, Donofrio, Ford Minutes were approved 4-0.

2025-123 **A Resolution authorizing the Executive to execute a construction contract with Eagle Abatement & Demolition, LLC. for** **demolition of the building, in an amount not to exceed $425,000.00, and declaring an emergency.**

Sponsor-Executive Shapiro Staff Contact: Mark Potter, (330) 643-2726, mpotter@summitoh.net Ms. Walters moved to suspend Council Rule 8.01 (A): the requirement of three readings at a Regular Council meeting. Voice Vote on the motion. Yes: Darrow, Dickinson, Donofrio, Ford Motion passed-Voice Vote: 4-0 Ms. Walters moved to adopt. Voice Vote on the motion. Yes: Darrow, Dickinson, Donofrio, Ford Motion passed-Voice Vote: 4-0 Resolution 2025-123 was adopted.
